messages:
amal: Quick sync on DP onboarding runway + graduation rules. Need a one-pager we can share with prospects by Friday.

rachel: On it. Do we do a single rubric or variant by deployment type?

sandeep: Single baseline + small addenda for Dedicated (SLA/throughput) and Private (networking/compliance).

amal: Baseline fields: onboarding time, integration signal (API/SDK), core workflow coverage, quality regression gates.

maria: Can we be concrete on onboarding time? Suggest: reference integrations in 10 business days.

james: For VPC/on-prem partners call it 6-8 weeks with SRE support and an onboarding plan.

sandeep: Metrics to track: integration days, 95p latency delta, cost delta per 1k requests, partner NPS. Pre/post comparisons.

amal: Also add feedback velocity (actionable issues/week) and median time-to-fix for P0/P1. That shows product impact.

rachel: Drafting the one-pager now. Will include purpose, timeline, commitments (us vs partner), cadence, and exit criteria.

amesages (dp-coordinator-bot): FYI — DP intake form link: https://redwood.internal/dp-intake (includes traffic profile, compliance needs, integration owner).

maria: Exit paths: 1) Graduate to GA if thresholds hold for 4 consecutive weeks, or 2) Graceful offboard if partner deprioritizes. Need clear handoff for both.

james: Proposed graduation thresholds: 1) 95p latency <1.5x baseline, 2) cost delta <10% after recommendations, 3) integration within target, 4) SLOs + runbook documented.

sandeep: Plus regression tests and at least 10% sample prompts passing our quality checks (or partner-specific eval).

amal: Rollout phases: Intake -> Kickoff -> Integration -> Stabilization (observability + runbook) -> Graduation/Offboard. Assign owners per phase.

rachel: SE leads technical kickoff; CS owns stabilization and business signoff; Product owns quality/regression gating. Agree?

maria: Agree with that split. SE + CS should co-own the weekly check-ins until stabilization.

james: Weekly check-in template: 3 bullets — blockers, recent wins, asks. Keeps meetings 15m.

sandeep: I'll add a DP intake red-flag checklist: legacy infra, compliance blockers, missing integration owner, <1k monthly calls.

amal: Incentives: small stipend + engineering hours + launch visibility > pure credits. Add NDA/data handling in intake.

rachel: Adding a short FAQ to the one-pager: what partners get (priority support, roadmap influence, credits/hours) and expectations (feedback cadence, test data, dev time).

sandeep: Need an abort criterion: if integration stagnant >8 weeks without a plan, trigger formal offboard checklist.

amal: Good. Rachel — post the draft in #product and ping us for quick signoff. If we land this today, outreach next week.

rachel: Draft posted: https://redwood.share/dp-onboard-onepager — please leave comments by EOD. :thumbsup:
